steps.title: 7. Biometrics: a different animal

steps.description:
This one doctype carries two unrelated things, and which fields you fill decides which.

Sick-off — employee, start and end date, reason. Saving it raises a Sick Leave Application for that person, so the absence reaches HR without anyone keying it twice.

Biometric punch — the Biometrics tab, one row per tap at the clinic door. These are what Clinic Visits on the dashboard counts, and what a Clinic Visit Cost is matched against to prove somebody was actually there.

Fill the fields marked required and press Save (Ctrl+S). The onboarding step ticks itself off as soon as the record exists.
